title: IO Read Failed
content: Segment file read failed. Check: disk health (smartctl), filesystem permissions, NFS mount stability. If persistent, run corecruxctl verify-store.

title: IO Write Failed
content: Segment file write failed. Check: disk space (df -h), write permissions, filesystem read-only state.

title: Segment Corrupt
content: BLAKE3 hash mismatch on segment data. Run corecruxctl verify-store --mode full. If confirmed, the segment needs replay from a replica.

title: Invalid Frame
content: Frame header hash mismatch. Likely a truncated write during crash. corecruxd handles this automatically via commit marker truncation on restart.

title: Backpressure Active
content: Append rejected due to backpressure. The system is under load. Wait and retry with exponential backoff. Check /metrics for corecrux_backpressure_active gauge.

title: Shard Not Owner
content: Request routed to wrong node. This happens during shard rebalancing. Retry — the client should re-fetch the shard map and route correctly.

title: Epoch Mismatch
content: Shard epoch changed (rebalance in progress). Retry with updated shard map version.

title: Operation Timeout
content: Operation exceeded deadline. Check: disk latency (iostat), network latency, lock contention (/metrics corecrux_store_lock_wait_seconds).

title: Internal Error
content: Unexpected internal error. Check daemon logs for stack traces. Report at github.com/CueCrux/Crux/issues if reproducible.

title: Low Coverage
content: Query returned coverage.score < 0.5. Try broader terms, check get_gaps(), or inform user the corpus doesn't cover this topic.

title: Session Not Found
content: Session ID not found. Create a new session with save_session.

title: Invalid Parameters
content: MCP tool received missing or invalid parameters. Check the tool's inputSchema.
